seo.title: Lumina Atelier | Premium Beauty Studio in Germany
seo.description: Modern beauty studio in Germany offering lashes, brows, skincare, PMU, head spa and elegant online booking.

common.tagline: Editorial luxury meets precise beauty care

luxury.title: Treatments shaped by calm execution, precision and a visibly refined finish.
luxury.description: Lashes, brows, skin and PMU in an atmosphere that feels clean, feminine and quietly confident.

transformation.title: Before and after should never feel loud. It should feel balanced.
transformation.description: We focus on natural harmony, clear lines and results that stay strong both in daily life and on camera.

booking.title: Booking designed like a mini atelier: clear, fast and elegant to navigate.
booking.description: Choose service, specialist, date and time with transparent availability directly inside the page.

trust.title: Quality becomes visible through hygiene, guidance and composed technique.
trust.description: Personal care, modern products and a process built for comfort, trust and consistency.

services.title: Treatments with a clear artistic point of view instead of generic packages.
services.description: Every service is framed to look elevated, feel calm and remain easy to understand and book.

lashes.title: Lash Extensions
lashes.description: Soft to fuller sets with attention to retention, eye-opening balance and clean symmetry.

brows.title: Brow Styling
brows.description: Shape, tint and finish adapted to facial structure, skin tone and desired intensity.

facial.title: Facial Treatment
facial.description: Deep cleansing, hydration and glow protocols for sensitive, tired or demanding skin.

pmu.title: Permanent Make-up
pmu.description: Precisely pigmented soft looks for brows or lips with an individual pre-draw.

headSpa.title: Head Spa
headSpa.description: Scalp ritual with massage, steam and care for deep relaxation and polished lengths.

antiAging.title: Anti-Aging Treatment
antiAging.description: Gentle active treatment for firmness, freshness and a calmer skin surface.

makeup.title: Make-up
makeup.description: Soft glam, bridal or event looks with modern skin texture and precise color work.

consulting.title: Skincare Consultation
consulting.description: Personal analysis with product guidance, routine planning and realistic care goals.

gallery.title: Editorially curated results with a natural visual finish.
gallery.description: Not an overloaded portfolio, but a selected edit of work that highlights technique, shape and finish.
gallery.comparisonDescription: Move the slider to explore the change from starting point to final finish.

airLashes.title: Airy Volume Set
airLashes.note: Light density with a more open eye and a soft transition.

softBrows.title: Soft Definition Brows
softBrows.note: Cleanly shaped brows with natural depth and refined definition.

glassSkin.title: Hydra Glow Ritual
glassSkin.note: Balancing protocol for calmer, more hydrated-looking skin.

lipBlush.title: Velvet Lip Blush
lipBlush.note: Subtle pigment with a clearer lip contour.

bridalGlow.title: Editorial Bridal Glow
bridalGlow.note: Skin-led make-up with reflective light and defined eyes.

browLift.title: Brow Lift Balance
browLift.note: More structure, even direction and a refined finishing line.

experience.title: A visit should feel guided, calm and precise from start to finish.
experience.description: Instead of a basic timeline, each step has a role: understand, assess, treat, protect and follow through.
experience.visitTime: Most visits take between 60 and 150 minutes depending on the service

consultation.title: Step 1: Consultation
consultation.body: We discuss the desired result, daily routine, skin or hair condition and define the right finish together.

analysis.title: Step 2: Analysis
analysis.body: Shape, proportion, skin response and product selection are mapped out carefully before treatment starts.

treatment.title: Step 3: Treatment
treatment.body: The application itself is carried out with focused technique and as little visual noise as possible.

aftercare.title: Step 4: Aftercare Guidance
aftercare.body: You receive practical advice for longevity, recovery and the right home-care routine.

followUp.title: Step 5: Follow-up
followUp.body: When needed, we plan a refill, review appointment or care adjustment straight away.

booking.title: A booking module that feels closer to a premium tool than a plain form.
booking.description: Choose your service, specialist and time slot in a calm, elegant flow. Already booked times cannot be selected.
booking.occupiedNote: Already booked times cannot be selected.
booking.summaryEmpty: Please choose a service and a time slot first.

success.title: Your request has been received
success.description: We confirm the appointment after a short availability check by phone or email.

validation.email: Please enter a valid email address.

prices.title: Clear pricing architecture with room for personal consultation where individuality matters.
prices.description: Final pricing may vary slightly depending on consultation, technique and additional effort.
prices.note: Final prices may vary slightly after personal consultation.

reviews.title: The quietest compliments are often the most valuable.
reviews.description: Clients describe not only the result, but also how clear and pleasant the whole appointment felt.

one.quote: The studio feels beautifully calm, the consultation is honest and the result looks elegant instead of overdone.
one.author: Miriam S.

two.quote: What I loved most was the lack of pressure. My brows finally match my face instead of dominating it.
two.author: Aylin K.

three.quote: My facial appointment felt technically strong and deeply relaxing at the same time.
three.author: Julia R.

four.quote: Booking was very clear and the specialist understood exactly how natural I wanted the PMU to be.
four.author: Sofia M.

five.quote: Very clean studio, high quality products and a finish that still looks polished days later.
five.author: Deniz T.

about.title: A modern beauty studio in Germany focused on quality, aesthetics and personal care.
about.description: Lumina Atelier combines a calm studio experience with contemporary technique, clear visual language and individually adapted treatments.
about.storyBody: We believe luxury beauty work does not need to feel loud. For us, premium means sharp analysis, precise execution and an atmosphere where clients feel safe and understood.

quality.title: Quality before speed
quality.body: Every appointment leaves room for consultation, execution and finishing.

aesthetics.title: Balanced aesthetics
aesthetics.body: We prefer results that support facial features instead of covering them.

care.title: Personal guidance
care.body: Routine, aftercare and next steps are tailored to each client.

team.title: The team
team.description: Three specialties, one shared standard of care.

lara.name: Lara Muller
lara.bio: Calm, symmetrical looks focused on retention and natural line work.

amina.name: Amina Kaya
amina.bio: Skin analysis, glow protocols and softly pigmented finishes with precision.

sofia.name: Sofia Hnatiuk
sofia.bio: Relaxing rituals and modern event looks with polished skin texture.

studioNotes.ambience: Quiet cabins, soft light direction and clear material choices.
studioNotes.technology: Modern tools, hygienic processes and thoughtful aftercare.
studioNotes.care: Treatments are planned around daily life, skin needs and desired intensity.

faq.title: Important questions before your appointment, answered clearly.
faq.description: If anything is still open, we are happy to advise you personally before booking.

bookingChanges.question: Can I move my appointment?
bookingChanges.answer: Yes. Please let us know as early as possible so we can offer the best alternatives.

cancellation.question: How does cancellation work?
cancellation.answer: You can cancel easily up to 24 hours before the appointment. Late cancellations may be charged proportionally.

duration.question: How long do the treatments take?
duration.answer: Usually between 45 and 150 minutes depending on the service. Exact durations are visible in the service cards and booking module.

preparation.question: How should I prepare for the appointment?
preparation.answer: Please arrive without heavy eye or skin products if possible, and let us know about allergies or special wishes in advance.

aftercare.question: Do I get aftercare instructions?
aftercare.answer: Yes. After every treatment we provide practical guidance for longevity, recovery and suitable home-care products.

payment.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
payment.answer: In the studio we accept card payments, cash and often contactless payment.

contact.title: Central, calm to reach and designed for personal care.
contact.description: Visit us in the studio or message us directly on WhatsApp or Instagram for a quick question.
contact.mapNote: Only a few minutes from Savignyplatz station. Parking garages and public transport are close by.
contact.parking: Step-reduced access and nearby parking options are available.

imprint.title: Imprint
imprint.body: Demo website for a beauty studio in Germany. The live version would include full provider details, responsible party information and registry data.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: In this demo, form and cookie data are simulated locally only. A live project would present full GDPR privacy details here.

cookies.title: Cookies
